verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy-posture question for an infrastructure control plane that manages resources such as databases, but the evidence pack documents no retention or deletion-policy controls for user data. The only related item is automatic protection of Providers from deletion while they have active managed resources. That is an adjacent safeguard for packages, not control over data retention or deletion, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
